entities.title: utv-core typed API (net.icelander.utv)
entities.summary: The Maven artifact net.icelander.utv:utv-core 0.3.0 for Java 21+: one package, net.icelander.utv, with immutable typed values, Outcome<T> for partial operations, typed policies and TemporalContext.
consumers: Application developers who put utv-core on their class path
The example suites under src/test/java/net/icelander/utv/examples, which show it
guarantees: Values are immutable with representation equality; of throws IllegalArgumentException for a value that cannot exist, tryOf and parse return an Outcome and never throw for bad input.
Only partial operations return Outcome (Unique, Multiple, None, Unsupported, Invalid); every case carries the shared diagnostic codes of library-api §5.
Comparable only where an order always exists (CivilDate, CivilYearMonth, CivilTime, CivilDateTime, FixedOffsetDateTime by instant, Instant); ZonedIntent is ordered only by TemporalContext.compare.
toString() is the text form utv-text/1; toJson()/fromJson give exactly one UTV JSON value.

Nothing reads the system clock, host time zone, locale or network; zone rules come only from ZoneRules the caller loaded, except that toZonedDateTime checks an asserted offset against the JDK's tz database.
Names follow library-api §6, except TemporalValue.parse for the contract's Utv.parse (README).
entities.compatibility: SemVer 0.x (VERSIONING.md): the library is pre-1.0, so a minor version may change the API; each change is listed in CHANGELOG.md. 0.3.0 kept the 0.2 JSON layer and deprecated, rather than removed, its renamed members.

relationships.description: toJson() and fromJson read and write utv/1.0 values.
Every typed operation calls the JSON layer underneath.

entities.title: utv-core JSON layer (0.2)
entities.summary: The everyday API on UTV JSON values held as Jackson JsonNode: Values, Iso, TextForm, Operations, Intervals, Zones, RuleBundle, JavaTime, Utv and GregorianCivil, each operation returning a UtvResult (utv-result/1.0).
consumers: Application developers who work with UTV JSON directly
The typed layer of this library
EverydayFixturesTest and TextFormFixturesTest, which run the shared fixtures through it
guarantees: Builders produce the canonical shapes of everyday-api and do not validate.
Operations never throw for semantic outcomes: invalid, unsupported, none, multiple and symbolic are statuses of the UtvResult.
Utv.parse rejects duplicate JSON keys; Utv.validateStructural fails closed on unknown versions, kinds and properties.
The 0.1 validation API keeps its structural utv.* codes; operations report them beside malformed-value.
entities.compatibility: Kept unchanged in behaviour from 0.2 on (library-api §7). 0.3 renamed ResolutionPolicy.Gap.SHIFT_FORWARD_BY_GAP to Gap.SHIFT_FORWARD and deprecated ResolutionPolicy.REJECT and Operations.MonthEnd, keeping them working.

relationships.description: UtvResult, a subset: schema, operation, status, diagnostics, candidates.
